name: agentic-os
description: The Workbench HUD's source, which the AgenticOS Workbench app (app/) compiles

scripts.check:hex: sh -c "! grep -rnE '#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}' main.ts src --include='*.ts' | grep -v 'src/ui/tokens.ts' | grep -v 'src/ui/tokens.test.ts' | grep ."
scripts.test: npm run check:hex && node --require ../tools/test-env.js --import tsx --test $(find src -name '*.test.ts' | sort)
